---
title: "Shared settings for the three convergence studies"
output: html_document
---

Edit the settings (including the default `profile`) in this helper, then run each notebook's setup and parameter
chunks again. All three studies use the same physical equation, analytic exact
solution, L2 space-time error norm, time horizon, and accuracy conventions.
Each saved run includes the complete shared settings and their fingerprint.
Runs with different fingerprints belong to different experimental suites.

The common requested h/tau window has six logarithmic points in the pilot and
eight in full, with endpoints 1e-4 and 1e-2. Actual uniform mesh lengths and
time steps are saved and plotted. Endpoint ratios remain 100. The profiles
share the physical problem; full adds points and tighter auxiliary settings.

The small diffusion coefficient is deliberate: at T=0.5 it reduces the
rational-operator error in the h study sufficiently to expose the spatial
error down to h=1e-4. It changes the physical problem and does not improve the
rational approximation's relative rate error. The sinusoidal forcing stays
physical and is not multiplied by diffusion. Larger diffusion/horizon values
require a fresh calibration; accuracy checks can then fail.

The `coefficient_source` default below selects the same source for all studies.
`"package"` uses rSPDE's orders 1--4 and retains the existing experiment defaults.
`"computed"` uses the audited MATLAB coefficients, orders 1--8, generated at
the exact beta values 0.25, 0.45, 0.65. Changing this one default automatically
sets the m-study range and the fixed order in the h and tau studies: 1--4 and
4 for package, 1--8 and 8 for computed. The physical problem stays the same.
Computed coefficients reject unsupported alpha values rather than interpolate
or silently select another source. Their CSV and provenance JSON live in `matlab/`.
No MATLAB process is required when running the notebooks. Computed m=8 reaches
errors around 1e-14 for these data, so its m study automatically uses finer
auxiliary grids: h=2.5e-9 (pilot), 1.25e-9 (full), and tau approximately
2.25e-16 in both profiles. The package grids remain h=1e-6/5e-7 and
tau=1e-11/5e-12. The h/tau studies retain their original auxiliary grids.
Saved refinement checks still enforce the 5% tolerance; no points are discarded.
The computed-source error evaluator uses a stable coefficient difference to
avoid subtracting two order-one solutions when their difference is near 1e-14.
These tiny auxiliary grids require the modal backend; direct stepping is not
practical. They are scalar grid descriptions, not allocated meshes/time vectors.
The computed time step leaves room to halve it within the exact step-index
limit of 2^52; further reductions need a new representation/precision audit.

Cubic interpolation applies to the package tables; computed coefficients use
exact-beta lookup and ignore `root_interpolation`. A finite-order fitted slope
need not equal the asymptotic upper-bound slope in the paper.

With fixed m and very fine meshes, the sampled rational error over the entire
FEM spectrum can be large even when the active-mode error is small. These
smooth finite-mode experiments test the chosen data; they do not establish
uniform accuracy for arbitrary initial data or forcing across that spectrum.

`uniform-modal` is the default for these finite-mode uniform-mesh studies.
It evaluates the same FEM/backward Euler scheme without explicitly taking
billions of sparse steps. The direct solver remains available for manageable
grids. See the derivation and restrictions in `convergence_experiments.Rmd`.
The worker/cache settings apply to direct stepping; the modal backend needs
no large temporal cache. Memory budgets continue to cap the worker count.

```{r}
convergence_settings <- function(study, profile = "pilot", coefficient_source = "computed") {
  study <- match.arg(study, c("h", "tau", "m"))
  profile <- match.arg(profile, c("pilot", "full"))
  coefficient_source <- match.arg(coefficient_source, c("package", "computed"))

  # Shared scientific experiment: change these here, not in individual notebooks.
  T_final <- 0.5
  diffusion <- 1e-4
  kappa <- 4
  N_finite <- 4L
  active_modes <- c(5L, 7L)
  exact_initial <- c(10, 0)
  exact_forcing <- c(0, 10)
  AAA <- 1
  OMEGA <- pi
  alpha_vector <- c(0.5, 0.9, 1.3)
  range_window <- c(1e-4, 1e-2)
  range_points <- if (profile == "pilot") 6L else 8L
  study_range <- 10^seq(log10(range_window[1]), log10(range_window[2]),
                        length.out = range_points)

  # Shared numerical accuracy and execution settings.
  solver_backend <- "uniform-modal"
  root_interpolation <- "cubic"
  quadrature_order <- 4L
  step_sum_order <- if (profile == "pilot") 64L else 128L
  run_refinement_checks <- TRUE
  refinement_tolerance <- 0.05
  workers <- if (profile == "pilot") 4L else 8L
  temporal_cache_mib <- 512
  memory_budget_gib <- NULL

  # Auxiliary grids isolate the variable studied; they need not be identical.
  m_fixed <- max(rational_supported_orders(coefficient_source))
  h_study_tau <- if (profile == "pilot") 1e-10 else 5e-11
  tau_study_h <- 1e-5
  if (coefficient_source == "package") {
    m_study_h <- if (profile == "pilot") 1e-6 else 5e-7
    m_study_tau <- if (profile == "pilot") 1e-11 else 5e-12
  } else {
    m_study_h <- if (profile == "pilot") 2.5e-9 else 1.25e-9
    # Both profiles must permit a halved-step check with N <= 2^52.
    m_study_tau <- 2.25e-16
  }
  m_vector <- rational_supported_orders(coefficient_source)
  coefficient_info <- rational_coefficient_info(coefficient_source)
  for (alpha in alpha_vector[alpha_vector < 2]) for (m in unique(c(m_fixed, m_vector)))
    my.get.roots(m, alpha/2, root_interpolation, coefficient_source)

  h_vector <- uniform_tadpole_h(study_range)
  tau_targets <- study_range
  time_grids <- lapply(tau_targets, function(dt) experiment_grid(T_final, dt))
  tau_vector <- vapply(time_grids, function(g) g$time_step, numeric(1))
  stopifnot(length(unique(tau_vector)) == range_points,
            max(tau_vector)/min(tau_vector) >= 100*(1-1e-12),
            max(h_vector)/min(h_vector) >= 100*(1-1e-12))
  h_fixed <- uniform_tadpole_h(if (study == "tau") tau_study_h else m_study_h)
  time_grid <- experiment_grid(T_final, if (study == "h") h_study_tau else m_study_tau)
  axis_values <- switch(study, h = h_vector, tau = tau_vector, m = m_vector)
  anchor_h <- if (study == "h") min(h_vector) else h_fixed
  anchor_grid <- if (study == "tau") time_grids[[which.min(tau_vector)]] else time_grid
  anchor_m <- if (study == "m") max(m_vector) else m_fixed

  shared_parameters <- list(T_final = T_final, diffusion = diffusion, kappa = kappa,
    modes = active_modes, N_finite = N_finite, alpha = alpha_vector,
    initial = exact_initial, forcing = exact_forcing, A = AAA, omega = OMEGA,
    range_window = range_window, range_points = range_points,
    solver_backend = solver_backend, root_interpolation = root_interpolation,
    coefficient_info = coefficient_info, rational_update = "direct-products-factored-residues-v1",
    quadrature_order = quadrature_order, step_sum_order = step_sum_order,
    refinement_tolerance = refinement_tolerance, run_refinement_checks = run_refinement_checks,
    auxiliary = list(h_study_tau = h_study_tau, tau_study_h = tau_study_h,
                     m_study_h = m_study_h, m_study_tau = m_study_tau, m_fixed = m_fixed),
    error_method = if (coefficient_source == "computed")
      "uniform-modal-stable-difference-v3" else "uniform-modal-projection-v2")
  suite_id <- digest::digest(shared_parameters, algo = "sha256")
  fixed <- switch(study,
    h = list(m = m_fixed, time_step = time_grid$time_step),
    tau = list(h = h_fixed, m = m_fixed),
    m = list(h = h_fixed, time_step = time_grid$time_step))
  experiment_parameters <- list(study = study, profile = profile,
    diffusion = diffusion, shared = shared_parameters, suite_id = suite_id,
    requested_range = study_range, axis = axis_values, fixed = fixed)
  execution_settings <- list(workers = workers, temporal_cache_mib = temporal_cache_mib,
                             memory_budget_gib = memory_budget_gib)
  list(experiment_profile = profile, T_final = T_final, diffusion = diffusion, kappa = kappa, N_finite = N_finite,
    active_modes = active_modes, exact_initial = exact_initial, exact_forcing = exact_forcing,
    AAA = AAA, OMEGA = OMEGA, alpha_vector = alpha_vector, study_range = study_range,
    h_vector = h_vector, tau_targets = tau_targets, tau_vector = tau_vector,
    m_vector = m_vector, h_fixed = h_fixed, m_fixed = m_fixed, time_grid = time_grid,
    time_grids = time_grids, axis_values = axis_values, anchor_h = anchor_h,
    anchor_grid = anchor_grid, anchor_m = anchor_m,
    solver_backend = solver_backend, root_interpolation = root_interpolation,
    coefficient_source = coefficient_source,
    quadrature_order = quadrature_order, step_sum_order = step_sum_order,
    run_refinement_checks = run_refinement_checks, refinement_tolerance = refinement_tolerance,
    workers = workers, temporal_cache_mib = temporal_cache_mib,
    memory_budget_gib = memory_budget_gib, shared_parameters = shared_parameters,
    experiment_parameters = experiment_parameters, execution_settings = execution_settings)
}
```
